heldout_observed_rate_check.criterion: held-out students observed item error rate
heldout_observed_rate_check.estimator: train students smoothed inverse success rate
heldout_observed_rate_check.interpretation: Cross-student descriptive reproducibility of observed rates; not learning gain, causal difficulty or independent ability-adjusted IRT.

limitations: Provided sequences are processed/truncated; record counts cannot reconstruct original interactions.
Many items require images, multiple blanks or option grading; the current numeric research adapter cannot handle all 7652 items.
No original student identifiers are included in the prepared item bank or inventory.
School grade and knowledge routes do not provide an independently calibrated item difficulty scale.
